decisions.decision: Pandemic mitigation items were agreed to be removed from the draft ARPA funding plan, since the CARES Act already covers them.
decisions.quote: when it came to pandemic mitigation noted in the draft there was agreement that it could be removed as it is already mentioned in the cares act.

decisions.decision: Funding for the Town Manager and Finance Director in the general administration budget was agreed to be removed from the draft ARPA plan.
decisions.quote: there was funding allocated to the town manager and finance director in the general administration budget and there was agreement to remove that as well

decisions.decision: Water and sewer departments were agreed to be moved out of the infrastructure allocation and combined into the general fund in the draft ARPA plan.
decisions.quote: there was also agreement to remove the water and sewer departments out of the infrastructure allocation and combine that into the general fund.

decisions.decision: By general consensus, the board decided not to reimburse burials and cremations from ARPA funds.
decisions.quote: discussion ensued and the general consensus was not to reimburse for burials and cremations.

decisions.decision: Town Manager Lemieux was directed to discuss using ARPA funds versus Capital Plan funds for the plow trucks and ambulance with the Finance Committee and Capital Planning Committee; the ARPA discussion to resume by February 21 at the latest.
decisions.quote: it was decided to allow town manager lemieux to discuss using the arpa funds vs. capital plan funds for the purchase of the plow trucks and the ambulance with the finance committee and capital planning committee.

decisions.decision: The board asked the Parks Commission for a cost figure for Marshall Park.
decisions.quote: it was also decided to ask parks commission for a number for marshall park.

decisions.decision: By general consensus, the board decided not to draft a bylaw prohibiting AirBnB-type rentals in residential zones; no action was taken.
decisions.quote: the general consensus of the board was not to draft a bylaw, so no action was taken.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager's recommendation is six capital projects totaling $1,360,500.00 out of requests the minutes give as $2,941,010.00 in total.
budget_items.quote: the recommendation tonight is for six projects totaling $1,360,500.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total cost of capital projects not funded in the current recommendation is stated as $1,580,510.
budget_items.quote: the total cost of projects not funded in the current recommendation is $1,580,510.

budget_items.topic: Funding sources for the six recommended projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The six projects are funded from raise and appropriate, free cash, unexpended capital and special purpose stabilization, with stabilization the largest share.
budget_items.quote: raise & appropriate free cash unexpended capital special purpose stabilization $356,789.09 $0.00 $17,710.91 $986,000.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Replacement of Rescue 1 is the first-priority capital project at a stated project cost.
budget_items.quote: project title: fd17-03 replacement of rescue 1 project cost: $506,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A replacement six-wheel dump/spreader/plow truck is listed at a stated project cost.
budget_items.quote: project title: dpw23-18 6 wheel dump/spreader/plow project cost: $240,000

budget_items.topic: Capital spending averages and unfunded requests
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Five-year and three-year average capital expenditures are stated, along with total 10-year capital requests and an estimated shortfall in funding.
budget_items.quote: our five-year average expenditure on capital is $1.62m and the three-year average is $1.63m.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital requests for the next 10 years total $35.47M and, at current funding, about $19.5M would not be funded.
budget_items.quote: given there are capital project requests totaling $35.47m at this point in time for the next 10 years, and if our funding remains consistent, we will not be funding approx. $19.5m in capital

budget_items.topic: Special Purpose Stabilization Fund for vehicles and equipment
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Article 10 would fund the special purpose stabilization fund for vehicles and equipment; $986,000 is to cover Rescue 1 and the two dump trucks.
budget_items.quote: (ms. lemieux noted the $986,000 would be used for the replacement of rescue 1 and the two dump trucks)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chiller replacement is complete with a remaining balance to close out.
budget_items.quote: the public safety building chiller replacement is complete with a balance of $5,954 with some remaining invoices to be paid.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road culvert and state grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Flat Hill Road culvert construction is budgeted at a stated amount and a $500,000 grant is to be applied to it.
budget_items.quote: the flat hill road culvert construction project ($394,210.00) will be put out for bid in march 2023, with construction in the fall. we also have a grant for $500,000 that will be applied towards that project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Page Street culvert construction has a stated project amount and is expected to go to bid in the spring.
budget_items.quote: the page street culvert construction project ($146,289.37) is expected to be out to bid in the spring

budget_items.topic: Ten-wheel truck with plow and sander
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The ten-wheel truck with plow and sander is ordered at a stated cost, with delivery moved to March 2024.
budget_items.quote: the replacement of the 10-wheel truck with plow and sander ($250,000) is ordered and delivery

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Master Plan proposals were received against a stated budget amount and are under review.
budget_items.quote: the master plan ($110,000) proposals were received on january 19' and non-price proposals are being reviewed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Marshall Park master plan design is complete with a stated remaining balance.
budget_items.quote: the marshall park master plan design is complete; we are seeking an estimate for schematic design. $13, 377 remains.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Police canine replacement has a stated cost and the new K-9 handler will begin procurement.
budget_items.quote: for the police dept. canine replacement ($24,250), newly appointed k-9 handler, officer jack wagner will begin the process of procuring the canine.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fire turnout gear funded at $100,000 has been fully expended.
budget_items.quote: she reported the turnout gear ($100,000) for fire has been fully expended.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Typical costs of burials and cremations are described when the board discussed reimbursing them; the board did not reimburse.
budget_items.quote: most burials vary from five to seven thousand dollars and cremations are usually two to three thousand dollars.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board signed a payroll warrant, an accounts payable warrant and a payroll deductions warrant, each with a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: the board signed a payroll warrant in the amount of $949,974.73; an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $570,230.79 and a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $59,004.37.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Parks Commissioner said a million dollars would achieve much of the Marshall Park work, and grants with matching funds are being considered.
budget_items.quote: she stated with a million dollars we can get a lot done.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Alonzo said past capital plans were about two million dollars before the tax situation.
budget_items.quote: he added in the past we have looked at two million dollar capital plans and we were poised to do the same until this tax situation happened.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Article 10 description lists a transfer from free cash into the special purpose stabilization fund.
budget_items.quote: transfer of $200,000 from free cash
